scope: Pure assignment and publication-time contracts only

assignment.seedFormat: 64 hexadecimal characters, sampled once by the generation owner
assignment.rowIdentity: Persisted internal recipe-row UUID; canonical lower case and stable ordering
assignment.cardinality: 1 <= N <= effective product count <= 400; every index appears and counts differ by at most one
assignment.retry: Validate and reuse persisted assignment; changed recipe/revision/N/seed refuses reuse
assignment.legacyCount: Missing read/create count defaults to one; missing PATCH field must remain preserved by its caller

publicationTime.scheduled: Local calendar minute + IANA zone + explicit resolved offset + matching UTC dueAt
publicationTime.dstGap: Refused without normalization to a different chosen time
publicationTime.dstFold: Explicit earlier/later choices, including elapsed-choice status; no silent default
publicationTime.timezoneSeam: Existing launch date/zone validators and web @internationalized/date calendar seam
publicationTime.parity: Read-only PostgreSQL timezone conversions in isolated PGlite; UTC midnight, +14, Nepal +05:45, Kyiv/New York folds and Lord Howe half-hour fold/gap

limits: No N input, calendar control or live product journey is enabled by these helpers.
No video-set/publication storage, physical child generation, delayed worker or provider write is implemented by this proof.
No provider conditional-write policy is bypassed; owner behavior choice remains pending.
No full canonical verification, packaged beta or production activation is claimed.
